experiments.label: Preserved monitored whole-block run · original mostly_excl policy
limitations: One preserved monitored run; no repeatability estimate or new experiment.
The monitored ROI differs from its uninstrumented control by +0.024765% in time; these are the monitored counters, not a replacement for historical TSV timings.
Useful GEMM operations exclude softmax, packing and other work while ROI time includes them. SimdDotProd is an OpClass cross-check, not a dynamic mnemonic trace.
L1D–L2 monitor excludes the separate instruction-cache and page-walker paths. Physical DRAM counters include system traffic during the ROI.
Conditional issue/crossbar bounds are not intrinsic L1/L2 cache peaks. A projection/headroom is not a promised speedup or proof of the bottleneck.
The final cleanup dump is excluded; dirty cache contents are not flushed at the ROI boundary. Production tensor-value correctness is unobserved.
